title: Being quasi-compact is fpqc local on the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that quasi-compactness is fpqc local on the base (statement lines 5687-5691). The proof records base-change stability and Zariski locality, then treats a flat surjective morphism of affines with quasi-compact base change f': X' is quasi-compact and X' -> X is surjective, so X is quasi-compact, which is quasi-compactness of f; the general locality lemma concludes (proof lines 5693-5704). The level is H2: the reduction is short and the surjectivity step that transfers quasi-compactness from X' down to X is stated explicitly.
